title: Flying Lady Boat Tours

services.name: boat tour
services.desc: At the Flying Lady we only provide the best quality boats available. We work hard to keep our boats clean and up-to-date on all maintenance so your trip will be perfect. The Flying Lady is a 27′ Abel Marine that was pressed into service for Florida Boat Tours in Jupiter. Built in 1977 in Southwest Harbor, Maine, the Flying Lady is over 40 years old. Undoubtedly, Abel has produced some of the most beautiful vessels ever built. Unlike the competition, Abel Marine had a reputation for building the highest quality boat available.
